notes.title: Update Alpha 0.72.5 Optimizer
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

-Mines Entrance will now display Dialog if the player doesnt have the keys to unlock

-Ogre's Camp is now locked until Player finds the keys

-Ogre's Camp Entrance will now display Dialog if the player doesnt have the keys to unlock

-Totems can now be found around mines. They appear once the player unlocks the mines

-A Stone Gate was placed between Totem Room and Ocult room

-One of the clue text was edited in order to match the puzzle

-Clues now are easier to be spot

-Logan is no longer under the earth

-Widower is now standing at the right position

-Elder is now placed outside the Town Hall

-All the objects inside Town Hall were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-All the objects inside Inn were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-All the objects inside Blacksmith were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-All the objects inside Market were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-All the objects inside Barracks were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-All the buildings in Auguston (village, Bandits etc) were re-worked in order to achieve better optimization and FPS

-Mine A Room was partially optimized (It shouldnt have high FPS, but you may be able to go through some small objects)

-You will no longer be able to walk on Bard's head (inside the Inn)

-Family will no longer give you Lumberjack Contract

-Tutorial Cameras (2nd from Town Hall to Inn, 3rd from Inn to Market and 4th from Market to Gates - Bandits) were edited in order to give a better understanding on your next location

-No more characters getting stuck on the wrong spots during battle any more!

*NOTE FOR TESTERS
This update was mostly optimization. We ve decided to release it a bit earlier so we could fix few problems that testers may encounter during testing.
This updated was NOT tested (If I was testing the whole game, the update would have taken 2 more weeks. Instead I will be releasing small hotfix during the following weeks in order to fix (if any) bugs I have caused.


Things to expect:
-Mina A room (Mine Entrance/Dead Miner) has been optimized but not at full length. You may find yourself going through some hills or some extented walls. We are aware of this. We will fully optimize it on the next patch.

-Mine B room (Goblin Camp) and Mine C room (Puzzle Room) has NOT been optimized yet! You may still encounter some high FPS. We will optimize it while debugging the rest of the game. One room at a time (I couldn't take it any more. I had to work on something different....)

-The game should now run in a lower FPS and be more smooth.

- Battles shouldnt be buggy any more and Characters should return normally into their normal position.


Things NOT to expect:
-Change in Visuals and how the environment was (We havent remove any object. So it should look exactly the same as before. Only difference will be the FPS)

-Player be able to go through walls or any object (Minus the Mine A Room)

-Player falling off the map

-Player appear in the middle of nowhere (if you are wondering how it looks, you will know if it happens. Trust me)



If you encounter any of the mentioned above please let us know and we will fix it asap with a hotfix.

Thank you,

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.71.9
notes.content:
New crafting tutorial added to the game now. Crafting quest chain will automatically be activated after completing the quest “Turncoat” and the player receives their first “building order”. The new crafting quest chain is a way for both new and old players to learn more about the crafting system and farming materials.

Furnace must now be activated either using coal or lumber as a fueling source. Once activated the furnace will be usable for up to 5 minutes.

Lumber allows lower temperature crafting for materials mostly made of copper and iron

Coal allows higher temperature crafting for materials mostly made of bronze and steel

All mineral nodes have been changed. They now give random amounts of all minerals in small quantities depending on the rarity of the stone you are mining.

The new crafting quest chain will help new players learn about creating new buildings and using them for crafting. The player is not forced to partake in this quest but is strongly recommended in the game.

And as always we’ll keep rolling more content and improvements for crafting!

Patch Notes:

-Legacy Vendor Added. Can be found outside of market by the stalls. Player may purchase follower contracts: Lumberjack, Forge Apprentice, Spearman, and Crossbowman. We are working slowly to transition these older models out of the game, after which we’ll begin implementing 4 new followers to replace them. These new followers will be primarily spell caster based.

-Moved fallen son in “My Son, the Hero”, so players would need to defeat Brawl Deathspike before gaining access to the corpse.

-Lumberjacks now correctly disappear after being rescued.

-Some of the side quests were showing unusual layouts compared to the layout of the other quests. All quest text layout has now been set t the same.

-All side quests will display their title correctly.

-Player can now cancel the initial dialogue with the Arcane Priest inside the Inn.

-”Brothel” side quest investigation notification will now only show to the player once when the player enters the cabin and will not recur afterwards.

-”Lumbernapped” The family where the player returns to, has been moved to the inside of the town hall.

-”Flammable Materials” will now correctly show the right quest and not “A Dirty Experiment”.

-Standard dialogue grammatical and punctuation fixes.

-Standard lighting fixes for objects appearing too bright in the game.

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.71.6x “Equippable Weapons” New Bounty Hunter Follower
notes.content:
Hello everyone!,

We have a pretty exciting patch this week as we are happy to announce that we have achieved our first steps towards more character customization within the game. This new feature is only available to the Bounty Hunter at the moment, but we plan to start bringing this new animation and equipment system to ALL models in the game both friendly and enemies. We hope this will start bringing more interactions with the game and bring more entertainment to the game.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cZt0R33.jpg[/img]

On the Bounty Hunter, you can equip 3 different weapon sets. Sword and shield, dual daggers or sword and dagger, and greatsword.  More weapons will be added later but we thought we get these in first since the Bounty Hunter is a master of combat and has the ability of wielding any type of melee weapons. Most melee classes will have this option in the future with exception and variations with all the others. Same goes for range and spellcasters.

We’ve also introduced 24 new weapons to the game to help accommodate this new feature. All of them are available for purchase at the market. We are planning a big crafting overhaul for the next patch, so players will be able to craft these fine weaponries.

New Icons added to the Bounty Hunter Talent Tree!, our new 2D artist was able to finish our first skill icons, which we plan to have for all characters with talent trees.

More sound effects added to the Bounty Hunter, these are more generic combat sounds we are testing and will eventually start having for all characters.

The Bounty Hunter replaces the Mercenary Follower and can be recruited at either the Market or Inn.

Patch Notes:

-Arcane Ripple Bleed Bug finally fixed! No longer will you be tagged with a bleed effect after having the enemies life force go through the abyss from ripple effect.

-Music added for waking up. Something everyone wants, just like a nice cup of coffee too!

-Health UI on the left screen have been reduced in size.

-Goblins Level have been set to a random predefined range matching the flow of the player progression instead of matching the player level.

-Bandits Level have been set to a random predefined range matching the flow of the player progression instead of matching the player level.

-Random colliders near the gate entrances around the towns have been removed.

-SHOP UI has been fixed to match the new UI styles. Player will find it much easier to access now.

-ALCHEMY VENDOR added, you know where that random alchemist is? Standing in the middle of the field in front of where the lab will be? Well guess what? He sells all the basic alchemy goods you would get at a lab. This will help early players gain potions and a healing follower.

-ESC has now been reworded to be an alternative to tab, so now both do the same function.

-Minor Typo Fixes throughout the game.

-Fixed Console box from saying all party members names and will instead say “Party”.

-Some minor bugs were fixed

Thank you,

Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Patch Alpha 0.70.0 "Town Management"
notes.content:
Hello everyone!,

We have a fantastic update for you guys today. Introducing our new Town Management system. Keep in mind everything is in it's early development, but we we plan lots and lots content to this system.

Alright, lets get started. To access the town management UI, you can either interact with the work desk either in the new Town Hall or in your room on the top floor of the Inn.

Also note, all constructions are now done from this window and building signs are no longer needed and cease to exist. So any old saves with buildings built will be deleted, however, you can still rebuild those buildings again using the new window.

You'll notice a display in the middle of the new Town Management window. It shows a reputation system of Righteous, Pragmatic, and Authoritative. Below are the town status Happiness, Security, Production, Trade, and Surplus.

The reputation is still new and only have few mechanics. When the player defeats "Jericho Ironblood" 2 new Agendas will appear in the town management window, these agendas have choices the player will choose. There is no right decision, but each decision will have some type of impact on the town. Right now there is only 2 agendas in the game, but we will be adding a lot more in the future as well as changing dialog options to effect your reputation. Reputation also effects the status of your town too.

-Happiness increases tax income, but lowers surplus.

-Security increases the chance for the town to defend against a raid, but lowers production.

-Production increases the amount of goods your builds will produce, but lowers happiness.

-Trade increases trade income, but lowers security.

-Surplus increases vendor stock (Still in development, need to rework vendor system), but lowers trade.

Tax income, resources, and trade income are generated every game day (30 minutes)

Everyday hostiles will attempt to raid your town, if you fail the raid all current town supplies have a chance to be looted by the enemies.

We have a lot of big plans for the new systems in place and we'll be working hard to continue polishing it.

I also recommend starting a new game with this update.

Patch Notes:

-Town Hall remodeled

-Lumbermill remodeled

-Achievements for turning in quests for defeating bosses now work correctly.

-Advanced barracks shop now working properly.

-Build signs were removed.


Final Thoughts:

Right now, our next task is making a more in-depth tutorial to help accommodate new players to all the new features that we have in the game.
Short-term plans are putting in new Alchemist, Looter (Adventurer), and Bard with full ability tree into the game. We also plan on redesigning the town and adding more town features too. The main quest chain is still in the works, once that's finished, we can devote more resources to the new Ebonbell zone.

notes.title: Patch 0.65 "New Inn"
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Alpha 0.55 "Commander and Range Checks"
notes.content:
Alrighty, we got another big combat mechanic again. This time we have range checks for abilities, commander units, and “Look Out, Sire!” traits.

First, let me show you a picture of the battlefield, with drawn in zones. Below the picture I will explain each zone and it’s function.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/57Abaso.jpg[/img]

-Frontline:

The frontline is a preferable spot for melee units. Any unit in the frontline can only strike units from within the Melee Zone. In addition, frontline units can be attacked by melee units from the range zone.

Units in the frontline can also attack units in the range zone if no enemy exists in the melee zone. In addition, units in the frontline that flee will have a chance to rally back from the range zone before running into the retreat zone.

Ranged attacks (Thrown and Certain Spells are exempt) will not be able to fire from this zone.

-Melee Zone:

The melee zone consists of units locked in melee battle. Melee zone must be empty on the enemy side, before units can begin melee attacks into the range zone.

-Command Zone:

Each battle will consist of a commander (Arcanist for the player side). The commander is typically stronger than the other units, but may be lower level. The commander has command abilities at its disposal which can help buff his units on the battlefield. Most commanders will have a frontline that has units with the “Look Out, Sire!” trait. Which helps protect the commander from initial attacks. The commander is still bound by the rules of the melee zone, but with one exception, they can also used ranged abilities regardless of not being in the range zone.

The commander will never flee from battle, but rather “Waver” when he fails his morale check. The command zone also prohibits a lot of tactical abilities that are available to units outside the zone. This is assumed the commander stands his post issuing orders.

-Range Zone:

Any range ability can be freely used from this zone.

Melee attacks from this zone can only occur if the target is in the melee zone or if the melee zone is cleared. Anyone in this zone is protected from melee attacks until the melee zone is cleared.

Fleeing from this zone will automatically run off the battlefield without any chance to rally.

-Retreat Zone:

Any unit that ends its turn in this zone will have been counted as fleeing the battle and will be destroyed.

-Look Out, Sire!:

This trait is given to most melee units. This trait only triggers when the user with the trait is in the frontline and the enemy has targeted the commander. If the commander is targeted in such case, then a morale check will be performed by the commander, if passed, all users with the trait on the frontline will attempt to block their commander from harm, redirecting the damage unto them causing 30% of the actual damage. If two users attempt to “Look Out, Sire!” then both will be hit by the same amount.

Additionally, the Arcanist has an option to push his companions out of the way and take the damage himself, if the player so chooses. The enemy commander is not as heroic and will always let their minions take the hit.


Other Game Changes:

-Market has increased its overall stock by 500%

-All units in the middle of enemy groups have been replaced by a Commander.

-50% debuff on enemy base health has been removed.

-50% reduction to player and companion’s health gains per level.

-Dramatic increase in experience requirements, turns out. The current system allowed reaching level 10 way too quickly.

-Another attempt to try to fix the animation glitch.

No patches for a few days now. We are beginning our final work on the new UI and are dedicating all efforts towards that now.

Please don't expect too much from the new UI, it will still have a similar style and layout. But we wanted to make it sharper and more optimized. We also want to try to make the combat easier on mouse users.

That said, even when the new UI comes out, we will continue to build on top of it. We're not master developers, but we are working hard. Expect 0.60 in a few days.

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Patch Alpha 0.54 "Rule of 4"
notes.content:
Disclaimer: You will need to restart the game for the changes to take effect.

So I’ve scrapped the whole formula for everything out the window and made something a little more streamlined and informative.

Introducing the “Rule of 4”, the rule of 4 now allows every attribute contribute in someway to every statistic. Also we threw out the old attack formulas and have made a new statline known as “Expertise” expertise is essentially your attack/spell/utility power and you can see how much it is on the character sheet. You will notice higher damage from this result, but in return it’s a lot more balanced. All ally characters have had their base health upgraded by 500% to help accommodate the new stat changes. Enemy health will still stay the same and will make the combat go by a lot faster, but more dangerous if you get hit.

We’ve also implemented health regen and focus regen into every character, meaning you will generate health and focus while in combat on every turn, these stats can be upgraded by using the Rule of 4.

Another stat we’ve introduced is the toughness rating, the toughness rating now determines your chance of resisting combat effects such as bleeds, stuns, poisons, etc. All debuffs now will check against a target’s toughness before it can be applied.

New critical power stat has been added to determine how hard your critical strikes will hit.

We will be adding descriptions to all the attacks in the future so the player will know how much damage potential it has.

The rule of 4 is huge overhaul of the current battle and stat calculations, but has made great changes to the balance of combat.



Bug Fixes:

I tried to do as much as I can to fix the movement bug in combat where the character flips back and forth forever. I’m not sure if it’s fixed now, since I can’t duplicate the bug on my end. I’ve made some changes to the combat movement and I hope this will work. Also combat run speed has been increased by 20%.

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.5 "Fallback!"
notes.content:
Hello everyone!,

We are proud to present Alpha 0.50!

This patch focused mainly on the new combat mechanic known as “Morale”. That’s right everyone now has a new meter known as morale and it’s going to play an important role in combat.

Morale is based from 0-100, however each combatant have a different number for max morale such as 70, 80, or 90. Meaning they will be tested in combat. Throughout the game, events will arise in battle known as “Morale Checks”, these morale checks will take the current user’s morale and roll an invisible virtual 100-sided dice (RNG). If the number is lower than the user’s current morale, the user will pass his morale check, if he rolled over, that means he has failed and that could be bad news unless it’s the enemy.

What are morale checks for?

The main purpose of morale checks are to determine if the combatant will flee from battle or not. This is a 2-way street, so you can also use it to your advantage to route the enemies.

Morale checks to determine if a combatant flees are always conducted when the attacker uses an ability that would bring the defender below 30% health or if the defender was already below 30% (Which means evades can cause morale checks)

There are other things morale checks are used for as well, but I’ll let you find in the game. At the moment I have descriptions for abilities that use morale checks.

Things that can cause the combatant or it’s party to lose morale:

- Attacks done by Monstrous Creatures
- Fleeing the battle
- Dying
- Failing a Morale Check
- Special abilities that cause loss of morale

Exceptions to Morale Checks:

Party Leaders will never flee the battle, but instead “waver” if they fail their morale checks
Combatants with the “Fearless” Status will never fail a morale check
Stunned combatants are unable to flee the battle

We’ve also added some new tactics and commands to help accommodate the new system, don’t worry we’ll have a lot more coming.

Followers will now maintain Tactical Abilities, these abilities revolve around movement and strategy.

Arcanist does not have tactical abilities, but instead Command Abilities, these abilities revolve around assisting your party members.

Keep in mind this is just the basis for the morale system. We want to bring a lot more complex features to the table to help make a successful and fun system. We will be rolling out more ways to regenerate morale as will as attack others morale.

Other changes:

Made several changes to combat ability formulas and stats.
Added new turn order menu in battle
Added a temporary fix to camera issues from loading games and tutorials. We will have a more stable fix in the future, but for now these will work in the meantime.
Proper enemies will now be able to counter and block attacks
Increased base hit chance from 70% to 80%

To do List:

We didn’t really have a chance to go through the bug and suggestion list this time since we pushed for 0.50 really fast, so we can address some of the game-breaking bugs some people have been experiencing.

Final Thought:

So I’ve neglected a lot of stuff around the house and been on a top ramen diet. So tomorrow, I got a ton of real life errands I gotta run, so I’ll be gone for most of the day tomorrow, so if there is an emergency bug that needs to be hotfix, I won’t be on call, but I’ll be around in the evening.

Now, I’d like to go through the bug list and start rolling out some hotfixes for the next few patches.

Thank you,

Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Alpha 0.45c Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've added 3 more new quests to the notice board. These one's will focus in the caves.

We made some changes to the Arcanist. He will no longer learn moves by level up. We have now started laying the groundwork for a talent tree/ability hierarchic system to learn new abilities. We've also added 6 new abilities to the Arcanist and changes to the existing ones.

It's highly recommended to restart a new game for these effects to work properly, but as we roll out new talent tree for followers. Players will no longer need to start a new game to use them since all followers will be storing their talent points for future patches.

We've changed the cutscene interactions to give the player an option to skip them if one chooses to.


Moving Forward:

We've already begun work on Alpha 0.50 and will have a release sometime soon. 0.50 Is going to make a lot of changes to the combat system, stressing the importance of positioning and movement. We want every combat to feel like a chess match, where every decision can have an impact on the outcome of the combat and where sacrifices must be made for the greater good.

We'll also be introducing some new mechanics to the combat system as well. Even though we want it to be a turn-based styled fight, we don't want another generic JRPG attack spam runaround. We want to use the current turn-based style now and build unique mechanics around it.

Thank you
Stoneworks Games

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to Patch 0.40, this update focused on setting up the new camera system. The camera will now function as a proper RPG style camera. Hold right click to rotate, however, in battle you’ll need to hold left click to rotate.

We’ve also added the new Conscript Model into the game changing his name to Militia. The Militia has also been given a new ability learned at level 2 called “Hilt Smash”.

Changes and Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Weapon Rings have been fixed, problem was some melee classes did not have the counter attack passive which allowed them to counter in combat.

[*]New camera system has fixed camera freezing problems after loading a game at times.

[*]Clicking on different members in the character sheet will now register correctly now.

[*]Last stand is now correctly working, adding 30% health as well as max health. The particle effect will now properly show on other uses and effect will be removed once out of battle.

[*]Focus will now be restored to 100% of maximum upon finishing combat.

[*]Grass has been removed from the Blacksmith.

[*]Incorrect crafting recipes have been removed.

[*]Smelting is now working properly at the blacksmith.

[*]Old stairs at lumbermill changed with better working new stairs.

[*]Goblin Boss is now fixed and will appear in battle, allowing the player to finish “Hostile Takeover”

[*]The Alchemy Lab will now properly show all available craftables.

[*]Characters will no longer spam the Passives Box with the current passives that they have.

[*]All characters can now receive attribute points and distribute them.

[*]The experience stat will no longer clip with the character sheet box.

[*]Made changes to bleed effect to keep it from appearing where it shouldn’t

[*]Shield Bash is now working properly and will hit according to your hit rating against the enemies evade.

[*]When grappling hook kills an enemy, the enemy will die at the spot of reaching 0 health.

[*]Obrodian Shrine will no longer change colors.

[*]Inn Keeper dialog has now been fixed and will not follow the mouse.

[*]All big rocks in the world have been fixed and player will not be able to go through them.

[*]All companions have had their experience requirements extended by 120%, this will make their experience requirement at half of what is need for the Arcanist. This allows easier leveling for companions, since enemy difficulties are based on the arcanist’s level.
[/list]

Now that we got the game in playable state where the player has the tools needed to have fun with the game. Our new focus now is to start bringing out more content to the game, that means more loot, abilities, skills, tactics, quests, the whole chabang!. Of course, we’ll we keep smashing those bugs so please keep sending in your reports, they have been a huge help to us and we hope one day we can bring you quality you have come to expect!

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.3 “Just U and I”
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We decided to release 0.3 early with the UI changes, mainly because we’ve been getting a lot of complaints about the controls and cameras, so we want to get started on that right away. 0.3 features the new reconfigured UI that we will be building on. Listed below are the current features.

UI Changes:
[list]
[*]Main Menu keybind is now “Tab”
[*]Equipment and Character stats have been combined in one menu listed as Character Sheet. This was done so you can see stat changes between equipments and party members.
[*]Quest log now shows on main menu, instead of having it’s own screen. Alternatively, you can press “L” to view current active quests right away on your HUD.
[*]New screen called Ability sheet showing ability information, on this screen you can distribute attribute points to your characters here, configure talent tree(Under Development), and view ability descriptions. Attribute distribution only available to the Arcanist at this time, and may be given to other members in the future, will need feedback.
[*]New Bestiary Menu added, now you can view enemy statistics after you’ve defeated them.
[*]Battle UI is now done by tooltips, hover your mouse over an enemy to view his current status as well as your allies.
[*]Other minor changes to help with information display and convenient navigation.
[/list]

Disabled Features:

So I did a really stupid thing and upgraded to Unity 5.3 without making a backup. Turns out there is a bug in 5.3 that drops your fps to 5-10 when you're using particle systems that have a start value of 0 which is needed for the weather system as well as other features. Therefore, we had to disable the weather system for the time being as well as other particles until unity can get a fix out.

Battle Cameras have been disabled. They have been causing a lot of problems and messing with the flow of battle. This is only temporary as we are working on a new camera system for in and out of battle on the next patch.

Temporary Features:

We added WASD movement, but because we are still using the old animation and camera system, it’s going to look pretty bad, but we left it in so it will be easier to navigate the world for the time being.

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Reload crossbow can only be used after the crossbow has been shot, this will make sure the crossbowman will not reload twice in a row.
[*]Textures redone in the goblin den, the wood was incredibly bright, so we switched to darker textures.
[*]Cave Fight scene has had its floor redone to prevent clipping and characters becoming stuck.
[*]After defeating a visual mob of goblins, they’re disappearance will now save and not reappear during game load.
[*]Combatants will no longer get stuck in battle in the cave.
[*]Notice board has an added dialogue if no quest is available to prevent player from getting stuck after clicking OK without available quests.
[*]Fixed bleed effect showing at start of battle.
[*]Fixed bleed effect showing after battle.
[*]Korith Bandit Quest dialog fixed.
[*]Mercenary experience chart fixed as it is now the same as the other followers.
[*]All quest experience reward will be given to the entire party.
[*]Critical damage effect added.
[*]Loading from another scene will now properly point you in the correct direction forward instead of sideways or looking back at the door you came through.
[*]Tutorial re-edited to reflect change in keybinds.

Final Thoughts:

Our original plan was to keep adding fixes and bugs to the UI patch, but because of the persistent game breaking bugs and the need for new controls and cameras, we decided to work overtime on the UI, so we can have more time working with our new animation, control, and camera system which is our focus for 0.4. Please keep reporting those bugs and giving us feedback.

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.2 “Combat Ready”
notes.content:
Happy Holidays and a Merry Christmas!!!

What a week it’s been! We ended up releasing a little early, so everyone can enjoy the holiday break and give us some extra time for the next patch. So thank you everyone for being so supportive of our game and without further ado here are the patch notes.

[u]Follower Changes:[/u]

(Keep in Mind all effects are stackable)

Scout - Added “Fire Arrow”, similar to a regular arrow but automatically causes burning effect on the target. Learned at level 2.

Lumberjack - Added “Hatchet Throw”, now capable of throwing his weapon at the target causing higher damage and automatic bleed effect. Learned at level 2.

Rogue - Added “Poison Injection”, similar to regular attack, but will cause automatic poison effect to the target. Learned at level 2.

Adventurer - Added “Last Stand”, a special ability that allows the character to increase his maximum health by 30% as well as his current health. Additional effects are a 10% physical damage reduction from all sources. Effect can only be used once per battle and lasts for 5 Turns. After which the health is lost and the character suffers a “Shaken” effect. Learned at level 2.

Spearman - Added “Impale”, a deadly stab with the spear that causes high damage and automatic bleed effect with a chance to cause an additional bleed. Learned at level 2.

Crossbowman - Added “Reload Crossbow”, before the crossbow could fire every turn. The crossbow is extremely powerful and to offset its high damage was to require the player to reload after each shot.

Alchemist - Added “Smokescreen”, Can throw a bottle that causes smoke on impact. Smokescreen causes the enemies to lose 10% to their Hit Chance. Learned at level 2.
Also changed “Poison Bomb” to be learned at level 3.

Bard - Added “Heroic Tune”, Adds 3% to all stats, no stack limit, effect lasts until end of battle. Learned at level 1.

Mercenary - Added “Grappling Hook”, The mercenary can now throw out a hook which will grab the target (causing bleed) pull them towards the mercenary, where he will strike with his weapon causing another stack of bleed. Learned at level 2.
Enchanter - Added “Fireball”, Single Target, fire damage with burning effect. Is now the default attack. “Fire Blast” has been moved to level 2 and is now an AOE ability.

Forge Apprentice - Added “Head Crack”, A overhead strike with the hammer that will cause the target to be stunned.

Conscript - We decided not to make any changes to the conscript because Richard is getting close to finishing his new model of the conscript at which time we’ll be assigning new animations and abilities to it.

[u]Quest Changes:[/u]

In 0.1 the quest system sucked and was very outdated. So we decided to throw it out the window and remake a new system.

The new quest system now allows players to track their progress, show up quest markers on the navigation bar (Some quest may not have this feature to maintain it’s mysterious location), and where to bring back the quest. It also lists what the rewards are before you accept the quest, can let you know during the quest, as well as finishing the quest.

The 3 main quests that were in the game have been redone to fit into the new system, so anyone who has finished those quests will lose their progress. We’re really sorry, but after setting up the new foundation, this won’t happen again. Also those quests now properly work with steam achievements and you will get them after completion and finishing the dialogue with Korith.

Added 3 new quests to the notice board, each one will give a steam achievement upon completion.

[u]Music[/u]

Efe has finished two tracks for us already (The first one was a demo he completed for us when we first met). We’ve switched out the generic theme in the game and swapped it out with his track. Even though the previous track was good, it was being used by hundreds of other games. Also added his demo track to the main menu. So main menu has new music and Auguston has new music.

[Weather]

We’ve added a working weather system into the game with day/night cycle. It’s still in it’s infancy, but it gives us what we need to build on top of it. Expect more tweaks to the weather system in the future.

We also changed the general feel of Auguston. Blood of Magic is suppose to be a dark fantasy game and we want to start transitioning into that. So you’ll notice the weather seems a bit more gloomy, it also matches the new track a lot better too.

[u]Combat[/u]

I know, I know. The combat is impossible. Well that’s what we want to fix.

All enemies have had their base health reduced by 50% except for bosses. Keep in mind that they will still have their regular bonuses from Stamina.

Combat AI has been completely redone to give a more tactical feel, instead of pure RNG.

Melee enemies will always choose a target nearest to them. Ranged enemies will still choose their target with RNG. Enemies with a wide variety of abilities now run through a cycle, using buffs/debuffs on their first turn and gradually moving to towars using their power move instead of using it right off the bat.

We’ve added a new feature in the battle menu known as “Tactics” which we will be consistently updating features for this new ability in the future. However, for today we have 1 new tactic that players can use to accommodate the new battle AI.

The new ability is known as “Advance Forward”, it can only be used when all your front line units have died and the user is positioned in the back. This allows a combatant in the backfield to move forward and take position at the frontline. Since melee units attack the nearest enemy, this tactic helps protect the arcanist when the tanks are down.

[u]Harvestables[/u]

Added all harvestable plants to the game world. Now players can harvest all alchemical plants for potion crafting at the Alchemy Lab.

[u]Camera[/u]

Changed combat cameras will need feedback.

[u]Additional Changes[/u]

-More optimization tweaks
-Added an Inn-Keeper upstairs of the Inn who can heal your party for 150 coins.
-Fixed a section of a cave that was missing it’s entire level!
-More collision tweaks
-Added volume options in the game for those who couldn’t save those options from the main menu.
-Exit now finally works in every instance, no more black screens!
-Tutorials from Korith now have “OK” buttons, so the story won’t be zipped past you.
-Changed starting party to Mercenary, Spearman, Scout, and Crossbowman all starting at level 1.
-Health and focus potions can now be used out of combat.
-Focus has now been properly fixed, it was matching the max health, it has now been changed to max focus.
-Experience has now been fixed. Before experience was compounded, now every time you reach a level the experience bar will start back at 0.
-Other minor bug fixes.
-No more annoying mouse hovering noises.

[u]Final Thoughts[/u]

It’s a lot of changes and we hope you’ll enjoy them. I’m sure there might be some bugs, but we’ll provide hotfixes over the weekend if needed. Also please give us feedback, whether good or bad, we’d like to hear it and it’s going to help out our development in the long run.

In this patch we didn’t make much changes to the UI even though there has been a lot of complaints about them. Don’t worry! the UI is our top priority for the next patch 0.3. We’re going to throw out the old ui and redo the whole thing from scratch. We want to build a strong foundation for a very modern UI filled with seamless information and statistics, because knowing is half the battle and we want our players to enjoy stat checking and strategy balancing.

Now if you’ll excuse me, I’m going to go pass out. So I won’t be able to reply to any immediate feedback.

Thank you,
Stoneworks Games
